about: Nu messages that no htmlverify rule matches (spec §12.3): what htmlverify doesn't check yet (gap), and what it accepts on purpose (disagreement). Each example, checked under standard, must still produce its message unmatched; test/nu.test.ts checks that and the corpus against this list.

gaps.message: ^Table columns? (?:\d+|in range \d+…\d+) established by element “t[dh]” ha(?:s|ve) no cells beginning in (?:it|them)\.$
gaps.reason: htmlverify doesn't run HTML's table model, which places cells by colspan and rowspan; a11y/table checks headers only.

gaps.message: ^Table cell spans past the end of its row group established by a “(?:thead|tbody|tfoot|table)” element; clipped to the end of the row group\.$
gaps.reason: htmlverify doesn't run HTML's table model, so it doesn't see a rowspan that runs past its row group.

gaps.message: ^A table row was \d+ columns? wide and exceeded the column count established by the first row \(\d+\)\.$
^A table row was \d+ columns? wide, which is less than the column count established by the first row \(\d+\)\.$

gaps.reason: Media queries are CSS, which htmlverify leaves to CSS tools.

gaps.message: ^Element “[^”]+” not allowed as child of element “(?:svg|math)” in this context\. \(Suppressing further errors from this subtree\.\)$
gaps.reason: htmlverify doesn't model SVG or MathML content; there it checks only attribute case and accessible names.

gaps.message: ^The “[^”]+” element is a completely-unknown element that is not allowed anywhere in any (?:SVG|MathML) content\.$
gaps.reason: htmlverify doesn't model SVG or MathML content; there it checks only attribute case and accessible names.

gaps.message: ^The document is not mappable to XML 1\.0 due to two consecutive hyphens in a comment\.$
gaps.reason: HTML allows -- inside a comment and XML doesn't; htmlverify checks HTML's comment syntax only.

gaps.message: ^Attribute “slot” not allowed on element “svg” at this point\.$
gaps.reason: DOM gives any element, SVG included, a slot attribute that assigns it to a shadow root's slot; Nu's SVG schema lacks it. Vanilla Breeze components slot SVG icons and charts this way.
gaps.example: Text

gaps.message: ^When the “srcset” attribute has any image candidate string with a width descriptor, the “sizes” attribute must also be specified — unless the following “img” element has a “loading” attribute set to “lazy” and a “sizes” attribute value starting with “auto”\.$
gaps.reason: Nu reports a whose own srcset has no width descriptors when the after it has them. HTML requires sizes only for an element's own width descriptors; htmlverify reports a or that needs it (content/missing-attribute).

gaps.message: ^Consider using the “h1” element as a top-level heading only
gaps.reason: An h1 is a level-1 heading wherever it sits; htmlverify checks levels (a11y/headings) and, in strict, allows one h1 per page (policy/single-h1), which covers Nu's note there.
